description: [Seller reputation: x402 seller risk check, plus an audit record] Before paying an x402 seller, POST its Base wallet and/or its endpoint URL. Returns a 0-100 score, verdict trusted / caution / avoid / unknown, components, reasons, and an audit record (reputationReceipt). Signing is OFF today, so the record is unsigned; see GET /.well-known/gw8-receipt-key. Heuristic, not a guarantee. $0.01. Free first: GET /api/seller/reputation/status. Paid: $0.01 USDC on Base, paid in-band via x402 MCP (@x402/mcp; _meta "x402/payment"). Also at POST https://micro-saas-agent.onrender.com/api/seller/reputation.
